card.name: Ending of given names like Olga
card.fires_on: The final piece of a personal name, mostly "ga" in Olga and "ar" in Oskar, right before a surname or possessive. It also fires weakly on the ending of other split-up words.

modes.label: Olga as a first name
modes.description: The "ga" ending of Olga, followed by a surname.

modes.label: Oskar as a name
modes.description: The "ar" ending of Oskar, the name of a king or a general.

modes.label: Other split-up words
modes.description: The ending of a brand or foreign term that is cut into pieces, such as ORLADEYO.

card.plain: It marks the last part of a name like Olga or Oskar, just before the surname.
